producer_report.summary:
I added docs/system-facts.md and put it in the planner and critic briefs. A new test fails when the budget lines in the file drift from the computed ones.

The file has 11 sourced facts. Budget lines use the form `- budget reader: 1997 of 2000`. The recorded sizes are contract 326/350, reader 1997/2000, producer 1257/1300, verifier 1298/1300, planner 788/1300 and critic 742/1300. It names `boundary_words()` in `xtask/tests/policy.rs` and lists no banned words.

- **briefs.rs:** a new `pub const SYSTEM_FACTS` embeds the file. Both `planner_brief` and `critic_brief` add a "System facts" section after the reading. Three new tests check that both briefs carry the file whole, that every fact has a source and the file is under 5000 bytes, and that it holds no `@` and no banned word.
- **budgets.rs:** I added a helper that computes the (set, size, budget) rows and a checker that compares them with the file's budget lines. `system_facts_budgets_match_computed` runs the checker on the real file. `system_facts_drift_is_rejected` doctors a size, then a budget, removes a line, then adds an unknown set; each is rejected.
- **CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md:** I added a changelog entry and appended D123 at the end of the decisions log, since a test pins the earlier bytes.

Prompt budgets are unchanged. The planner and critic budgets cover only the contract and the frame, so the added section does not count against them.

The SSH remote and plain-copy facts cite your request, because I found no code behind either. `parse_remote` in `gh.rs` accepts `ssh://github.com/...` URLs. Please confirm those two facts or point me to their source.

fmt and clippy are clean. The budgets tests pass (4) and the athena-context tests pass. The full `cargo test --locked` returned without an error exit, but its output was too long to read, so I saw only the exit status.

checks_run.note: first run failed on a substring banned-word check in my new test; fixed to whole-word matching and reran the system_facts tests (3 pass)
4 tests pass: the 2 existing and the 2 new
Ran once; the command returned without an error exit. I could not grep the saved output, so I did not read the per-test results.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/system-facts.md is short and states every requested and added fact (squash-merge/linear history/up-to-date branches; producer one-commit snapshot; plain copy without git or records/ for reader, planner, critic; prompt sets with budgets and current sizes; plan request format; land lands only a job's PR; records on athena/records after C0; SSH remote refused at admission; per-PR and per-branch caches; early PR and land waiting for CI), each with a source.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the file. It has 11 fact bullets, each with a Source line. The briefs.rs test the_system_facts_state_every_fact_with_a_source_and_stay_short checks a marker for each fact, a Source in each bullet, and a size under 5000 bytes. It passes under cargo test -p athena-context. The SSH and plain-copy facts cite the user's request because I found no code for them.

criteria_check.criterion: The file does not list the banned boundary words and names boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs as the source; no email-like text appears in it.
criteria_check.evidence: The test the_system_facts_name_the_boundary_source_and_hold_no_banned_word_or_email passes. It asserts the file contains 'boundary_words()' and 'xtask/tests/policy.rs', has no '@', and contains no word from boundary_words() as a whole word.

criteria_check.criterion: A briefs.rs unit test asserts planner_brief and critic_brief output contains the facts file text; run `cargo test -p athena-context`.
criteria_check.evidence: planner_and_critic_briefs_carry_the_system_facts_whole asserts both briefs contain SYSTEM_FACTS and a '## System facts' heading, placed before the checks (planner) and before the plan (critic). It passes.

criteria_check.criterion: A budgets.rs test fails when the budgets or current sizes recorded in the file differ from the computed ones, and a negative case with a doctored value is rejected; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
criteria_check.evidence: system_facts_budgets_match_computed runs the checker on the real file. system_facts_drift_is_rejected changes each set's size, then its budget, then removes its line, then adds an unknown set. Each is rejected. Both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The existing planner and critic budget tests still pass with the file included; run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets`.
criteria_check.evidence: every_role_set_is_within_its_budget and an_over_budget_role_set_fails both pass in the 4-test run. Budgets are unchanged. The planner is 788 of 1300 and the critic 742 of 1300. Their briefs sit outside the budgeted sets.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/decisions.md records the call (file, brief inclusion, drift test).
criteria_check.evidence: Added an Unreleased/Added entry to CHANGELOG.md and appended D123 at the end of docs/decisions.md. D123 covers the file, the brief inclusion, the drift test, alternatives and provenance. It has a Provenance bullet, and the entry was appended, not inserted, so the log-structure test still holds.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass at the repository root.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings gave no output or errors. cargo test --locked returned without an error exit.

open_issues: I found no code that refuses an SSH remote at admission. gh.rs parse_remote even accepts ssh://github.com/... URLs, as its own test shows. The file states the fact and cites the user's request, and D123 says so. The user should confirm the fact or point to its code source.
I found no code that makes the plain copy without git or records/ for the reader, planner and critic. The file cites the user's request for that fact.
The existing every_role_set_is_within_its_budget test still repeats the set composition that computed_rows() now holds. I kept it unchanged to keep the diff small. Both could share the helper later.
The full cargo test output was too large to read here. I saw only the exit status.
mistakes: My first banned-word test used substring matching and failed on a harmless fragment. I changed it to whole-word matching, like the real scan.
learnings: The budgets test's planner and critic sets are CONTRACT plus the frame only. Briefs are outside every budgeted set, so the new section does not change any budget.
budget_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs is the name the request gives, but the pub boundary_words() list is in briefs.rs. Both exist.
docs/decisions.md is append-only. A test pins the hash of its first 230046 bytes, so new entries go at the end.
Sizes recorded now: contract 326/350, reader 1997/2000, producer 1257/1300 (max over capabilities), verifier 1298/1300 (max), planner 788/1300, critic 742/1300.
The planner brief test forbids 'p10' and '0.97', and the critic test forbids 'cost', 'usd' and '$'. The facts file avoids them.
desires: A way to read saved tool output files inside the working directory, to confirm the full test results line by line.
